tool.name: nf-core falint
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ fa-lint \\ -threads ${task.cpus} \\ $args \\ -fasta $fasta \\ > >(tee ${prefix}.success.log >&1) \\ 2> >(tee ${prefix}.error.log >&2) \\ || echo "Errors from fa-lint printed to ${prefix}.error.log"
if [ \$(cat ${prefix}.error.log | wc -l) -gt 0 ]; then echo "Validation failed..."
rm ${prefix}.success.log else echo "Validation successful..."
rm ${prefix}.error.log fi
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": fa-lint: \$(fa-lint -version) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
A fasta linter/validator
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: falint Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/falint ]]>
